boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Saint Louis University rituals and recurring campus events, from a luck-seeking statue stop to welcome-week and seasonal gatherings.

cards.title: Rub the Billiken's Belly
cards.subtitle: Drury Rally Plaza, outside Chaifetz Arena
cards.notes: Stop at the Billiken statue outside Chaifetz Arena and rub its belly if you want to take part in the campus good-luck custom.
cards.short_summary: A shiny-bellied mascot statue anchors SLU's best-known luck ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU documents the tradition of rubbing the Billiken statue's belly for luck; the base plaque says those who rub its belly will have good luck.
cards.source_title: You're in Luck: The History of SLU's Billiken Statue
cards.access_notes: The statue is in Drury Rally Plaza outside Chaifetz Arena; access conditions are not stated on the source page.

cards.entity_name: New Student Convocation and Family Welcome
cards.title: Begin at New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Chaifetz Arena
cards.notes: If you are arriving as a new Billiken, attend the Convocation and Family Welcome ceremony, which officially marks the start of the SLU journey.
cards.short_summary: SLU frames Convocation as the beginning counterpart to Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU states that New Student Convocation gathers new students at Chaifetz Arena and symbolizes the beginning of their time at the University.
cards.source_title: SLU Welcomes Home Newest Billikens at Convocation
cards.access_notes: The cited 2025 ceremony took place at Chaifetz Arena; consult SLU's current calendar for future dates.

cards.title: Watch the Welcome Week Outdoor Movie
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week on the Quad
cards.notes: Check Welcome Week programming for the outdoor movie and bring a blanket or seat for a shared film night on the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A Quad movie night opens SLU's Welcome Week programming.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes the Welcome Week Outdoor Movie as a film night on the Quad where students gather and receive free popcorn.
cards.access_notes: Presented as a Welcome Week highlight; confirm the current program, location, and weather plan with SLU.

cards.title: Join PaintSLU
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week campus event
cards.notes: Wear clothes that can get messy and follow event guidance for PaintSLU, SLU's campus-wide paint-and-water gathering with music and dancing.
cards.short_summary: A color-filled Welcome Week paint and water event.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU identifies PaintSLU as a campus-wide paint and water fight during Welcome Week, with music, dancing, and color.
cards.access_notes: Wear appropriate clothing and follow current event instructions; location and participation details can vary.

cards.title: Meet Up at the Billiken Block Party
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week campus event
cards.notes: Look for the Billiken Block Party during Welcome Week to sample the event's food, karaoke, crafts, silent disco, and other scheduled activities.
cards.short_summary: A back-to-school gathering built around low-pressure activities.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU lists the Billiken Block Party as a Welcome Week celebration featuring food, a silent disco, karaoke, crafts, and more.
cards.access_notes: This is a Welcome Week event; verify the current schedule and any participation details with SLU.

cards.title: Mark the Year at Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Start-of-year Jesuit observance
cards.notes: Attend or observe the Mass of the Holy Spirit at the start of the academic year; SLU explicitly welcomes students of all faiths.
cards.short_summary: SLU's opening-of-year observance connects campus life to Jesuit practice.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU calls the Mass of the Holy Spirit a Jesuit-university tradition dating to 1548 that marks the beginning of the academic year and welcomes students of all faiths.
cards.access_notes: Listed on SLU's academic calendar; verify the current venue and time before attending.

cards.title: Show Up for Billiken Soccer
cards.subtitle: SLU soccer match tradition
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled Billiken soccer match and join the campus crowd for the school-spirit experience highlighted during the start of the year.
cards.short_summary: Soccer is presented as an early introduction to SLU school spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes attending a high-spirited Billiken soccer game as a way new students get their first taste of SLU school spirit.
cards.access_notes: Check the current athletics schedule, venue, and ticket information before attending.

cards.title: Circle Homecoming and Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Fall campus-and-alumni weekend
cards.notes: Use the current Homecoming and Family Weekend schedule to pick a game or campus event and reconnect with family, alumni, and the SLU community.
cards.short_summary: A fall gathering that brings students, families, and alumni together.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes Homecoming and Family Weekend as a fall tradition where families visit, alumni return, and games and campus events bring generations together.
cards.access_notes: Dates and individual activities vary by year; use SLU's current event information to plan.

cards.title: Gather for Christmas on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The Quad, first week of December
cards.notes: Visit the Quad in early December for the tree-lighting gathering, with carols and hot chocolate, and plan around the current event announcement.
cards.short_summary: A finals-season tree-lighting and carol gathering on the Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes Christmas on the Quad as a first-week-of-December tradition with carols, hot chocolate, and the lighting of the campus Christmas tree.
cards.access_notes: SLU places the event in the first week of December; verify the annual date and weather plan.

cards.title: Take a Wellness Week Break
cards.subtitle: SGA weeklong campus program
cards.notes: Review SGA Wellness Week offerings and choose a low-key activity, such as meditation or a therapy-dog visit, that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A week of student-focused care activities tied to cura personalis.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes SGA Wellness Week as a weeklong program with therapy dogs, meditation, free food, goat yoga, and other stress-relief activities.
cards.access_notes: Specific activities vary; check the current SGA schedule and any event requirements.
